svg.title: How a lock file and a version fix themselves
svg.desc: A pull request changes composer.json, package.json or a version by hand, and a check fails. The job of the check runs the autofix of every step. Where Composer or npm refuses the lock file, composer validate or the dry run of npm ci fails, and the lock file is locked again with the least change, every other package at its version; a lock file that the tool takes stays as Renovate wrote it. Where a file has another version than the manifest of the release bot, fix version asks whether the manifest has another version than on main, outside the pull request of the release bot. If it has, fix version writes nothing and says to set the manifest back, which a person does. If not, it writes the version of the manifest back at the place of the step Version, and nothing else of the file. The fix bot commits what changed, and the checks pass.
